parameters.query: SELECT id, url, title, raw_content FROM articles WHERE status = 'extracted' AND content_hash IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 30
SELECT id FROM articles WHERE content_hash = '{{ $json.content_hash }}' AND id != '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid AND status != 'rejected' LIMIT 1

UPDATE articles SET content_hash = '{{ $('Generate Hash').first().json.content_hash }}', status = 'summarizing' WHERE id = '{{ $('Generate Hash').first().json.id }}'::uuid
